azimuth.policy: inherit the source specimen orientation represented by the WS1 LUT; the source does not provide a numeric azimuth, so none is invented

referenceCondition.geometryApplication: The WS1 LUT already contains the accepted fixed-geometry reflectance. WS5 applies no second MRS, BRDF, angle-gamma, glare, or reflector gain.

physicalReflectance.units: absolute relative-reflectance XYZ under the accepted D65 integration
